name: Order Management
author: Saadhyam AI
description: Automate sales order creation, status tracking, fulfillment updates, and cancellation workflows via AI Voice and Chat Assistant.

actions.name: Create Order
actions.description: Create a new sales order with customer details, items, and shipping address

actions.name: List Orders
actions.description: Retrieve a list of sales orders filtered by status or customer

actions.name: Get Order
actions.description: Retrieve details of a specific sales order by order number or ID

actions.name: Update Order
actions.description: Update customer details or shipping address for an existing order

actions.name: Update Order Status
actions.description: Update the fulfillment status and carrier tracking number of an order

actions.name: Delete Order
actions.description: Cancel or delete an existing order record

actions.name: Get Order Statistics
actions.description: Retrieve aggregated dashboard metrics including total revenue, order counts, and average order value

actions.name: Export Orders
actions.description: Export orders in CSV, Excel, or PDF format with optional status and search filters

actions.name: Plugin Health Status
actions.description: Return plugin system diagnostic health metrics and database connectivity
